# Lab 25.3: SQL Translation API & Migration MCP Server

## What We Are Going to Do
Translate queries from code with the SQL translation API, and see how an AI agent can call the BigQuery Migration MCP server to do the same.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Translate one query with the API.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">TOKEN=$(gcloud auth print-access-token)
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://bigquerymigration.googleapis.com/v2alpha/projects/$PROJECT_ID/locations/us:translateQuery" \
  -d '{"sourceDialect": "TERADATA", "query": "SEL TOP 5 * FROM sales WHERE sale_date &gt; DATE - 7;"}'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The response contains the GoogleSQL translation and any warnings. If the API version path has changed, check the **SQL translation API** page in the docs.

2. **[CLI] Translate a whole file from Python.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">pip install --quiet google-cloud-bigquery-migration
python3 - &lt;&lt;'EOF'
from google.cloud import bigquery_migration_v2 as bqm
print("Workflow client ready:", bqm.MigrationServiceClient().__class__.__name__)
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The Python client creates batch translation workflows (the same jobs as Lab 25.2) from code, for CI/CD.

3. **[Console] MCP server.** The BigQuery Migration MCP server exposes tools such as `translate_query` and `get_translation`. Add it to an MCP client (such as Gemini CLI, Lab 16.10) and ask: *"Translate this Snowflake query to BigQuery: SELECT IFF(x>1,'a','b') FROM t"*.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| API | Translate from scripts and pipelines |
| Python client | Batch workflows from code |
| MCP | Translation as an agent tool |
| Use | Automate large migrations |
